summary: Master the PEACE model and WZ method for ethical investigative interviewing. Gain skills in deception detection and evidence gathering. Enroll today.
lede: Investigative interview training helps investigators and audit, compliance, and HR professionals plan ethical interviews and gather accounts for internal inquiries. It covers case-file analysis, rapport and cognitive interviewing, the PEACE model, TED questioning, statement analysis, and managing resistance, with practice in remote interviews and investigative reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for uncovering the truth and managing the risks associated with internal and external investigations.
modules: Foundations of Investigative Interviewing and Ethics
Strategic Planning and Case File Analysis
Rapport Building and Cognitive Interviewing Techniques
Advanced Questioning Strategies and TED Techniques
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in an investigative, audit, or compliance role. Familiarity with basic corporate investigation procedures and internal policy frameworks is recommended. No prior formal training in the PEACE model or WZ method is required.
